scope: Reject the ESP32 build_opt.h response-file name, case-insensitively, as project data before native CLI execution. Harmless flag text was used; no arbitrary host program or plugin was executed.

cases.title: rejects ESP32 compiler response files at project, archive, export and persistence boundaries
accepts legacy projects but rejects traversal, Windows devices and case collisions
bounds per-file, total source and file count, and keeps file editing out of Blocks
hashes all files canonically and retains legacy single-source fingerprints
preserves every source through copies, persistence, snapshots, archives and validated backup
exports a complete Arduino directory and never merges into an existing export
refuses an existing junction/symlink export target without writing through it
project compiler-control headers cannot reach any CLI command
oversized and invalid UTF-8 build manifests cannot invoke upload
reports actual build boundaries and never represents a failed compile as post-build integrity success
changed CLI, core or library content and a rewritten environment manifest cannot reach upload
an environment changed during compilation cannot publish a successful uploadable build
modified external compiler or SDK content refuses upload and a during-build change invalidates older builds
compiler refuses provisional wiring and wrong, missing or unreadable toolchain versions before compiling
successful compilation records artifact hashes; stale source and changed artifacts refuse upload before invoking it
a failed, incomplete or interrupted rebuild invalidates a previously successful build
incomplete, duplicate and traversal artifact manifests cannot reach the upload command
upload uses compiled input without rebuilding and records success, failure and interruption distinctly
parses core JSON from stdout while retaining stderr warnings separately
cannot validate a mismatching CLI using a version string printed only to stderr
exposes only journals belonging to this service and records compiler/upload raw provenance

coveredBoundaries: Compile refuses before any CLI command
File-management UI rejects three case variants and permits an ordinary header
history: Initial added unit case used the wrong store inspection method; corrected before the final pass.
Initial GUI fixture tried to park before firstWindow; corrected.
Next GUI fixture omitted opening Studio settings; corrected.
Interrupted source R6 was replaced by fresh source R7 after fixture correction.
limits: Not an OS sandbox or a general compiler/toolchain safety proof. R7 freeze predates the extra forged-ZIP assertion only; that assertion passed in this separate current-source run.
